statement_name: The Statement on Social Justice and the Gospel (Dallas Statement)
fetch_methodology: Live site (statementonsocialjustice.com) is behind Cloudflare bot challenge and returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (verified 2026-04-28). Signature wall scraped via Wayback Machine snapshots of /signers/ pages 1-18 across 2018-09-07 through 2023-12-04. Multiple snapshots per page were merged and deduped on (name, location). Highest 'Join the List of N Signers' counter observed: 17,404 (Dec 2023). Many signer entries have no role/denomination/church data because the public wall only displays NAME + CITY/STATE — denomination and church fields exist in the underlying Gravity Forms entries but are not surfaced. Initial Signers (16) and Featured Signers (23) come from the homepage 'Initial Signers' and 'Signers' (featured) blocks, which DO include role/church/organization. Authors of the statement (per task description) are added with full metadata even though several do not appear on the public wall (signature wall lists supporters; authors are credited separately in the homepage Initial Signers strip).

pca-warhurst-signers-2020.interpretation: All apparent overlaps are HOMONYMS, not duplicate signatures. Verified by comparing locations: e.g. Warhurst's Ryan Baker is a PCA TE in Hills & Plains Presbytery, while Dallas Statement's Ryan Baker is in Cedar Hill, TX with no PCA tie. Howard Brown is the only common name across two opposing lists (warhurst + lament), where it is the SAME person (PCA Central Carolina); on the Dallas list 'Howard Brown' is a different person in Vermilion, Alberta. Effective doctrinal overlap with all four opposing-signal lists: ZERO.

notes: DATA QUALITY NOTES: (1) The signature wall lists individuals by 'First Last, City, ST'; some entries are churches (preserved as is_church:true). (2) Conrad Mbewe (Kabwata Baptist Church, Zambia), Joel Beeke (Heritage Reformed / Puritan Reformed Theological Seminary), Owen Strachan (then Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary), and Allen Nelson IV (Perryville Second Baptist, AR) were publicly identified as Dallas Statement signers in secondary sources (Founders Ministries / G3 / Tom Ascol's blog) but DO NOT appear in any Wayback-snapshotted page of the public signature wall this analysis covered. They may have been entered into the form but not displayed, or appear on a snapshot page not yet indexed. Treat these four as 'likely signers, not verified from this dataset'. (3) The site continued accepting signatures into the 2020s, peaking at 17,404. (4) No public statements of recantation by any prominent initial signer have been located as of 2026-04-28. The statement remains the public position of conservative-Reformed evangelicalism. (5) Signers cluster heavily around: Founders Ministries (Tom Ascol/Jared Longshore/Pray's Mill Baptist), G3 Conference (Josh Buice), Grace Community Church / Grace to You / Master's Seminary network (MacArthur/Phil Johnson/Darrell Harrison), Alpha & Omega Ministries (James White), Sovereign Nations (Michael O'Fallon), and the Reformed Baptist / SBC conservative wing more broadly. (6) TGC and Keller-aligned leaders are conspicuously absent (this was the 'Big Eva' split moment); the Letter of Lament 2025 / AMR Leadership 2026 / Warhurst 2020 / Revoice cohorts represent the opposing post-2018 alignment, with which this list has ZERO expected overlap.
